{{Term/Store|Armor|Armors|Series, ALttP, BotW, TotK|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite Manual|game= ALttP|page= 23}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|'''Armor'''|Inventory|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Armor|Inventory|TotK}}</ref> Armors go unnamed in {{TP}}. They are pieces of [[Clothing]] and protective covering that [[Link]] can wear.

==Location and Uses==
==={{ALttP|-}}===
{{Stub|ALttP}}
{{Descriptions ALttP}}

==={{TP|-}}===
{{Stub|TP}}
Suits of Armor can be found in [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. They are equipped with [[Spear]]s.

==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Main|Armor in Breath of the Wild}}
Armor serves a variety of purposes, primarily to provide [[Link]] with defensive padding, allowing him to endure more damage. Damage numbers are shown numerically in {{BotW|-}}, albeit indirectly. Each unit of damage normally deals a quarter of a [[Heart]] to Link. For example, an attack with a power of 4 will damage Link by one full Heart. By wearing Armor, Link can decrease the amount of damage he takes. Each piece of Armor has a numeric rating that contributes to Link's overall Defense. The higher Link's Defense, the less damage he will take from [[Enemy]] attacks. Wearing Armor subtracts the attack's strength value by Link's total defense value. Wearing Armor with a defense rating greater than or equal to the strength of the attack will reduce that damage to a quarter of a Heart, and no matter his defense, Link takes at least a quarter of a Heart of damage from any attack. Armors often pair with other pieces to form [[Armor Set]]s.

Certain pieces of Armor also provide [[Added Effect]]s that can boost Link's attack, movement speed on [[Snow]], [[Sand]], through [[Water]], or while [[Climbing]], boost his stealth capabilities, or protect him from the environment. Environmental hazards include [[Lightning]], [[Fire]], heat, [[Ice]], and the cold. Most clothing can be enhanced up to four times by the revived [[Great Fairy|Great Fairies]], with the number of available upgrades dependent on how many Great Fairies have been restored. Each upgrade comes with a certain cost of [[Material]]s. Armor Sets that have been enhanced at least twice may provide [[Set Bonus]]es.

If Link has no Armor on, some characters will comment on his state of undress.<ref>{{Cite|Aren't you...a bit chilly?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|I hope you'll permit me a question... If I may be so bold...are you not chilly?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|So...are you making a statement? Or are you always in such a state of undress?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|The fact that you showed up out of nowhere—and stark naked, no less—means you're likely a total creep. I'm sure even someone like you, who has given up on clothes altogether, will find something you like here!|Claree|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Huh... It's not every day you see topless Hylians around these parts.|Teba|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Hmm... I'm not sure about your fashion sense, but you're certainly a fine archer.|Teba|BotW}}</ref>

Extra pieces of Armor were added in the [[The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild#Downloadable Content|Expansion Pass DLC]], and some pieces can also be gained by scanning certain [[amiibo]] on the [[Wii U]] and [[Nintendo Switch]] consoles.

There are 107 pieces of Armor available to collect overall, of which Link can carry a maximum of 100 pieces in his [[Inventory]] at any one time.

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Main|Armor in Tears of the Kingdom}}
{{Stub|TotK}}
There are 135 pieces of Armor in {{TotK|-}}. Many pieces of Armor that could only be obtained by using [[amiibo]] in {{BotW}} can now be found in [[Treasure Chest]]s across the [[Surface]] and the [[Depths]]. The [[Ancient Set]], [[Salvager Armor Set]] and [[Gerudo Outfit]] no longer exist, along with the [[Old Shirt]], [[Well-Worn Trousers]], [[Warm Doublet]] and [[Nintendo Switch Shirt]]. The [[Phantom Ganon Set]] has been renamed to the [[Evil Spirit Set]]. An upgraded version of the [[Tunic of Memories]], the [[Champion's Leathers]], can be found in [[Hyrule Castle]].

Armor and damage calculations to [[Link]] works the same way as it did in {{BotW}}. However, the [[Weapon Strength|Strength]] of [[Weapon]]s used against Link is now calculated differently.
